source_caption:
Robert Pattinson, what an actor you are!

Robert Pattinson completely surprised director Antonio Campos and the rest of the cast by debuting his high-pitched Southern preacher accent live on set during his very first take for The Devil All the Time. 

Pattinson refused to work with a dialect coach, preferring to build the voice independently. While other cast members sent voice recordings to Campos during pre-production, Pattinson kept his vocal preparation private out of self-consciousness regarding early feedback. Campos called Pattinson a "mad genius who can do anything.
